class.name: Death Knight Class
lore: Choose the Death Knight Class

skills.name: Cursed Seal
lore: Strike your enemy to inflict a cursed seal, which builds up
with each attack up to 4 charges. Upon reaching full charge,
the marked enemy gets Weakness I.

skills.name: Death Strike
lore: Unleash a forward slash, knocking back enemies. On the third cast,
hurl chains of death forward, latching onto blocks or enemies and
pulling yourself toward the landing point. On the fourth cast,
step back and slam the ground with immense force, releasing a
massive necrotic shockwave.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Phantom Charge
lore: Inhale necrotic particles as your deathly wings unfold.
Charge forward with overwhelming force, dragging along any enemies
caught in your path and leaving chaos in your wake.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Wraithbound Chains
lore: Unleash chains of death forward, binding up enemies and slowly
dragging them toward you. Necrotic hands rise from below,
clutching at their targets and stunning them in place.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Soul Barrier
lore: Conjure a barrier of necrotic energy, granting yourself
invulnerability for a few seconds. During this time, all
incoming damage is absorbed and converted into healing,
restoring your health.
🕗 {duration}s Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Necrotic Whirlwind
lore: Spin your Necroslayer in a deadly vortex, slightly lifting
enemies into the air upon contact. As the skill ends, summon
necrotic claws to slash nearby enemies, healing yourself based
on the amount of enemies hit. Enemies get knocked back and slowed.
🗡 {damage} Damage
❤ {heal} Heal
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown

skills.name: Death Sentence
lore: Spread your deathly wings and soar into the air, inhaling
necrotic energy to slowly summon your soul blade, locating your
target zone. Dive toward the chosen location with terrifying force,
slashing all enemies with your soul blade.
Enemies with fully charged cursed seals are instantly executed,
leaving no chance of survival.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
